sentence: This project builds tools that use a few bits of information to reconstruct radio maps of wireless environments.
This project studies which viruses that attack bacteria can infect which strains of Escherichia coli, and builds models that predict this from the genome.
This project studies how large language models on wearable devices can give personalized healthcare through fast data searches.
This project studies quantum computing, quantum algorithms, and how materials and electrical engineering can help quantum technology.
This project studies how to make optimization methods that are learned from past tasks easier to interpret, trust and scale.
This project builds robots that can sense contact, spot when it is incorrect, and quickly change their grip or motion.
This project measures how fast microbes make nitrous oxide across an oxygen gradient in the ocean and works out which pathways they use.
This project builds fast optimization tools for the perception and control of autonomous systems, with mathematical certificates that show when an answer is trustworthy.
This project monitors plants in the alpine over the long term to learn how communities form and change and to forecast future community states.
This project designs beamforming, user association and precise positioning methods for wireless networks that use very high frequencies.
This project studies which features let mollusks survive as ocean conditions changed and predicts which species will go extinct.
This project builds generative AI models that learn causal relationships directly from data so they can reason about cause and effect.
This project designs molecular building blocks that give precise control over the surface chemistry of soft materials.
